title: HTML indentation is cosmetic
explanation: The same rules, but the indentation rule covers .mjs and .sh only. Choose this if the HTML template's 2-space style should not be a violation, and the tool should not flag a file for a cosmetic difference.

cases.original: Use 4-space indents in code and Markdown when the format supports configurable indentation.
cases.note: The rule checks .mjs and .sh. HTML is excluded, so the template is not flagged, and the original's "code" is read narrowly.
cases.suggestion: Say whether HTML indentation is covered; this candidate assumes it is not.

cases.original: Use spaces where the format allows a choice.
cases.note: A tab anywhere in the file is the violation.
cases.suggestion: Say "no tab characters" rather than "use spaces".

cases.original: free of spaces and non-ASCII characters.
cases.note: Checked against the file name only.
cases.suggestion: Say "filenames contain no spaces or non-ASCII characters" in one sentence.
